1	# Go — detection
2	
3	Declares when the `go` profile activates on a given set of files. Consumed by `klaude-plugin/skills/_shared/profile-detection.md`. Multiple profiles may activate additively on the same diff.
4	
5	## Path signals
6	
7	_None._ Go detection does not use path heuristics; file extension alone is authoritative (see Content signals).
8	
9	## Filename signals
10	
11	_None._ Go detection is extension-based, not filename-based.
12	
13	## Content signals
14	
15	A file activates the Go profile if its extension is `.go`. The extension match is authoritative; no byte-level content inspection is required.
16	
17	## Design signals
18

20	tokens:
21	  - Go
22	  - Golang
